About these terms

These Terms & Conditions govern your use of this website and, together with a written proposal or services agreement, our services. AM (trading as AM) is based in Pakistan. By using this website you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use it.

Using this website

You may use this website for lawful purposes only. You must not attempt to gain unauthorised access to the site or its systems, interfere with its operation, introduce malicious code, scrape it in a way that harms performance, or use it to send unlawful or misleading content. We may suspend access to protect the site or others.

Intellectual property

The content of this website, including text, design, graphics and code, is owned by or licensed to AM and protected by intellectual property laws. You may view and share links to pages for personal or internal business use. You may not copy, republish or sell our content without written permission.

Ownership of work we create for you is set out in your proposal or services agreement. Unless stated otherwise there, we may keep our pre-existing tools, templates and methods, and you receive rights to the final deliverables once all fees due have been paid.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: Confirm the intellectual-property position for client work (assignment versus licence, portfolio rights, third-party assets and fonts).

Our services

Descriptions of services on this website are general. The scope, deliverables, timelines, responsibilities and fees for each project are set out in a written proposal or agreement. We will perform services with reasonable skill and care.

No guaranteed results. Marketing outcomes depend on many factors outside our control, including competition, market conditions, your offer, your budget and changes made by advertising and search platforms. We do not guarantee rankings, traffic, leads, sales or return on investment.

Your responsibilities

To deliver services well, you agree to provide accurate information, timely feedback, approvals and access to relevant accounts and materials. You are responsible for ensuring you have the right to use any content, images, trademarks or data you give us, and that your products, services and claims comply with the law and with platform rules.

Fees and payments

Fees, currency, payment schedule and any deposit are stated in your proposal or invoice. Fees quoted for clients in Pakistan are in Pakistani rupees (₨) unless agreed otherwise. Advertising spend paid to platforms such as Google or Meta is separate from our fees and is paid by you directly to the platform unless the proposal says otherwise. Applicable taxes are added where required. Late payment may result in work being paused. See our Refund Policy.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: Confirm tax treatment (for example sales tax on services and withholding), accepted payment methods, late-payment terms and whether the business invoices foreign clients in other currencies.

Third-party services

Our work often involves third-party platforms and tools, such as advertising networks, analytics, hosting, payment providers and social networks. These are governed by their own terms and policies, and we are not responsible for their availability, changes or decisions (for example, an ad account suspension or an algorithm change). This website may link to external sites we do not control.

Disclaimers

This website and its content are provided “as is” for general information and are not professional, legal, tax or financial advice. We try to keep information accurate and current, but do not warrant that it is complete or error-free, or that the site will be uninterrupted.

Limitation of liability

To the extent permitted by law, AM is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, loss of profit, revenue, data or goodwill arising from use of this website or our services. Our total liability for any claim relating to a service is limited to the fees paid for that service in the period set out in the services agreement. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: Have a lawyer set the liability cap and exclusions appropriate to the agency's contracts and insurance.

Termination

Either party may end a services engagement by written notice as set out in the proposal or agreement. We may suspend or end work if invoices are unpaid, if you ask us to do something unlawful or against platform rules, or if the working relationship becomes unworkable. Fees for work done up to termination remain payable. Provisions that by nature survive termination (such as intellectual property, payment and liability) continue to apply.

Governing law and disputes

These terms are intended to be governed by the laws of Pakistan, and disputes will be handled by the courts or other forum stated in the services agreement. We encourage you to contact us first so we can try to resolve any concern informally.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: The governing-law, jurisdiction and dispute-resolution (for example arbitration) clause is a default only. The business owner and a Pakistani lawyer must confirm it, particularly for international clients.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. The revised version applies from the date it is posted. Last updated: 7 October 2026.
